skill_outcomes.skill_name: Relationship between Education and Society Analysis
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the relationship between education and individuals, communities, and society
Understand and analyze the structure of the Vietnamese education system and other countries
Understand and analyze the management system and development policies of education in Vietnam and other countries
Understand and analyze the goals of educational management at different levels of training
Apply tools to analyze and evaluate measures used in educational management at different levels of training

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Internationalization Impact on Educational Management Analysis
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the impact of internationalization on changes in educational management and ensuring educational quality
Practice effective communication and presentation skills
Practice negotiation, teamwork, group management, and time management skills
Possess the ability to use economic and social research methods to analyze policy issues, educational management, and decision-making
Possess the ability to analyze, advise, criticize, plan, organize implementation, supervise, and evaluate policies, programs, and projects in education
Possess the ability to work independently or in a team under changing working conditions
Possess the ability to identify and solve problems in practical educational organization management
Develop a spirit of service, social responsibility, and professional ethics
Develop the ability to self-study and adapt to change
